references.text: The triple designation 'El Elohim JHVH' (God, Gods, Lord) is used to emphasize God's absolute sovereignty and omniscience.
The same triple divine title 'El Elohim JHVH' appears here, expressing God's majesty and power.
The Lord looks into the heart and knows human inner thoughts and motives, as the eastern tribes appeal to God's omniscience.
The Lord searches the heart and tests the kidneys, a parallel to invoking God as the one who knows and understands the truth.
The term 'ma'al' (treachery/betrayal against the Lord) is used here in the same way as in Joshua 22:22.
The Lord searches all hearts and understands every scheme of thought - a parallel to the appeal that God knows the truth.
Everything lies naked and bare before his eyes, before whom we must give an account - God's omniscience as judge.
God searches the hearts and knows the mind of the Spirit, a New Testament parallel to God's omniscience.
